name: Khanmigo
summary: Khan Academy's AI tutor for learners and free teaching assistant for teachers.
description: Khanmigo is built by the non-profit Khan Academy. Teachers use it free to plan lessons, create materials and handle classroom tasks, while students and parents get personalised AI tutoring and help with homework, plus a writing coach. The learner and parent plan costs $4 per month or $44 per year, and districts can buy school-wide access. It covers subjects such as maths and science.

howToUse.title: Open Khanmigo
howToUse.description: Open Khanmigo. Teachers choose Sign up for free. Learners and parents choose Get Khanmigo. The non-profit behind it is Khan Academy.

howToUse.title: Plan lessons and classroom tasks
howToUse.description: If you teach, use it at no charge to plan lessons, prepare materials, and handle classroom tasks. The page describes building a rubric from unit plans.

howToUse.title: Tutor homework with the writing coach
howToUse.description: Students and parents get personalised tutoring and homework help, plus a writing coach. Khanmigo guides the learner toward the answer. Subjects such as maths and science are covered.

howToUse.title: Choose a learner plan or a district
howToUse.description: The learner and parent plan costs $4 per month or $44 per year. Districts can buy school-wide access. The page says classroom access for students goes through a school or district.

features_fr: Tuteur d'IA de Khan Academy pour les apprenants et assistant pédagogique gratuit pour les enseignants.
Khanmigo est construit par la Khan Academy à but non lucratif.

Les enseignants l'utilisent gratuitement pour planifier des cours, créer du matériel et gérer les tâches en classe, tandis que les élèves et les parents bénéficient d'un tutorat personnalisé par l'IA et d'une aide aux devoirs, ainsi que d'un coach en écriture.
Le plan pour l'apprenant et les parents coûte 4 $ par mois ou 44 $ par an, et les districts peuvent acheter un accès à l'échelle de l'école.
